sources.description: Vendor installation doc: default install contents, the slim alternative, the Python 3.11+ statement and the Gateway cross-reference.
Upstream pyproject: the default dependency line and the forwarded optional-dependency names.
PyPI project page: current version 2.54.0 and the published extras list.
Repository: creation date, star/fork counts and the README's description of Pydantic Validation in the ecosystem.
Vendor README: the current `output_type=` keyword and `result.output` accessor in the quickstart.
Vendor comparisons page naming the frameworks Pydantic AI is contrasted with.
Rendered installation page, which states the Python 3.10+ floor.

Google provider page. Documents the published Gemini-API example verbatim: "agent = Agent('google:gemini-3.7-flash')" (raw https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/main/docs/models/google.md line 43, sha256 41c774c41a626cc19dcd660d0a0173e33ced67f6bec30421de7dfc5c6bbe2613; rendered https://pydantic.dev/docs/ai/models/google/, both fetched 2026-10-08). Occurrences of 'gemini-2.0-flash' on that page: 0. It also states the `google:` prefix for the Gemini API and `google-cloud:` for Vertex/Google Cloud, and requires GOOGLE_API_KEY.
Anthropic provider page: `anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6` as the documented example string.
Ollama provider page: `ollama:qwen3` as the documented example string.
OpenAI provider page: bare `openai:` resolves to OpenAIResponsesModel, `openai-chat:` for legacy Chat Completions, and `openai:gpt-6-sol`.

Rendered provider directory; the source of the dated provider count. The raw page is linked from the article with the path https://pydantic.dev/docs/ai/models/overview.md and the rendered form with https://pydantic.dev/docs/ai/models/overview/.
Raw provider directory markdown counted programmatically on 2026-10-08.
Output documentation: output_type, the AgentRetries budget defaulting to 1, ToolOutput(max_retries=) and stream_output().
Agent documentation: constructor surface, run/run_sync/run_stream, @agent.tool and @agent.tool_plain.
Testing guide: TestModel, FunctionModel and overriding the model via pytest fixtures.

claims.note: Headline and description restate the refreshed scope: version 2.54.0, corrected provider strings and the output_type/result.output API. Both strings equal the Article JSON-LD headline and description verbatim.
Opening summary: what the framework does, the default install and the fact that four copy-paste surfaces from the April version no longer resolve on 2.54.0.

Framework identity, repository creation date 2024-06-21, current version 2.54.0 (PyPI 2026-10-03), star/fork counts read 2026-10-08, and the README's claim that Pydantic Validation underpins the OpenAI, Anthropic, Google ADK and LangChain SDKs.

The three provider extras the April page recommended (`openai`, `anthropic`, `gemini`) are not defined for the root package in 2.54.0; the published extras list and the pyproject forwarding lines are cited.
Python floor conflict recorded, not adjudicated: install doc says 3.11+, the rendered install page and PyPI metadata say 3.10+. The page recommends the stricter vendor statement.
GOOGLE_API_KEY is the environment variable the Gemini provider expects; taken from the vendor's Google provider page.
Framing sentence for the model-string table and the date it was verified against the vendor's provider pages.

Model-string table transcribed from the four vendor provider pages read 2026-10-08: openai:gpt-6-sol with the openai-chat: alternative, anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6, the Google row corrected in round 1 to the vendor's documented `google:gemini-3.7-flash` (S9) alongside google-cloud: for Vertex, and ollama:qwen3. The previously published `google:gemini-2.0-flash` was the April tag with only the prefix corrected and is not the vendor's documented example; it appears in this revision only inside the quoted library error message.

Renamed-prefix reproduction and the limits of the error message: `google-gla:gemini-2.0-flash` raises UserError naming `google:gemini-2.0-flash`, but construction validates the prefix and not the tag - `google:gemini-2.0-flash` and `google:gemini-3.7-flash` both construct and then fail identically asking for GOOGLE_API_KEY. The paragraph states the vendor's documented example is `Agent('google:gemini-3.7-flash')` (S9). Probe record under run.

run.methodology: Round-1 rerun. Isolated uv venv under the per-run $TMPDIR with pydantic-ai==2.54.0 on Python 3.12.13 (pydantic 2.14.0, openai 3.26.1, anthropic 1.12.1, google-genai 2.29.0): the page's own copy-paste surfaces plus both Google tags, run on the library's built-in TestModel path with no live API key. Covers model-string construction, Agent.__init__ signature, result_type=, result.data, result.usage(), output_type=/result.output, the TestModel override and the GoogleModel('gemini-3.7-flash') tag with a dummy provider key.

claims.note: Explicit correction of two April surfaces: openai:gpt-4o moved to the vendor's documented openai:gpt-6-sol, and the bare openai: routing to the Responses API.

Bounded, dated count over the vendor provider directory: 34 provider table rows and 37 distinct prefix strings, computed on the saved raw markdown; stated as a documentation count, not verified integrations.
Agent construction snippet using the current output_type= keyword and the documented openai:gpt-6-sol model; syntax verified on 2.54.0, no live API call.
The three changed API surfaces: result_type= raises TypeError, AgentRunResult has no .data (the accessor is .output), and usage is a property rather than a method. all_messages() remains a method.
Retry semantics from the vendor output page: per-output-tool counters, an AgentRetries budget defaulting to 1, agent.run(retries={'output': N}) and ToolOutput(max_retries=N).
Nested BaseModel example using output_type= and .output; syntax verified on 2.54.0 on the TestModel path.
stream_output() yields validated structured output during a run, so structured output and streaming are no longer mutually exclusive; the April two-call workaround is withdrawn.
Dependency-injection container declared as a dataclass; syntax verified on 2.54.0.
Agent constructor with deps_type= and output_type=; both keywords verified present in Agent.__init__ on 2.54.0.
Per-run deps= call form; verified on 2.54.0 that run_sync accepts deps.
Logfire snippet using logfire.configure() and logfire.instrument_pydantic_ai() as documented; instructions= used on the constructor.
Ollama FAQ answer: the ollama: prefix resolves through the vendor's documented example; the local availability of any specific tag is explicitly left open.
Retry FAQ restating the vendor's documented default of 1 with the AgentRetries and ToolOutput configuration forms.
Streaming FAQ restating stream_output() as the current supported path.
Section heading for the changelog; asserts no standalone fact.

Bullet list of the withdrawn or replaced April surfaces, now including the round-1 fix of the Google row: the April `google-gla:gemini-2.0-flash` is replaced by the vendor's documented `google:gemini-3.7-flash`, with the prefix correction and the google-cloud: Vertex route retained. Also covers result_type=, result.data, result.usage(), the non-existent provider extras, the [gateway] extra, GEMINI_API_KEY, the undated '20+ providers' count, the April star/fork figures, the streaming-exclusivity claim and the two unsourced production figures that could not be re-confirmed.
Provenance paragraph listing the vendor pages and metadata re-read on 2026-10-08; scope only, no new factual assertion beyond the list itself.

Verification note: the four copy-paste failures were reproduced in an isolated venv on 2.54.0 via the TestModel path, no live API key, no model-quality/retry/cost claim, and states the local runs are author-side verification that is NOT published as a reader dataset. Probe record under run.

run.methodology: Round-1 rerun. Isolated uv venv under the per-run $TMPDIR with pydantic-ai==2.54.0 on Python 3.12.13 (pydantic 2.14.0, openai 3.26.1, anthropic 1.12.1, google-genai 2.29.0): the page's own copy-paste surfaces plus both Google tags, run on the library's built-in TestModel path with no live API key. Covers model-string construction, Agent.__init__ signature, result_type=, result.data, result.usage(), output_type=/result.output, the TestModel override and the GoogleModel('gemini-3.7-flash') tag with a dummy provider key.

numbers.note: Star/fork counts (20,489/2,879), the version 2.54.0 and the provider-directory count (34 rows / 37 prefixes) were each re-read on 2026-10-08 and dated in the text; the count is labelled a documentation count, and no author-measured statistic is published as data.

model_ids.note: Every model string (openai:gpt-6-sol, openai-chat:, anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6, google:, google-cloud:, ollama:qwen3) was checked against the vendor provider page for that provider on 2026-10-08. The published Google row is the vendor's documented example `google:gemini-3.7-flash` (S9, which contains zero occurrences of gemini-2.0-flash); the April `google-gla:gemini-2.0-flash` and the library's suggested `google:gemini-2.0-flash` appear only as the rejected April form and inside the quoted error message, and the text says explicitly that neither is the documented example.

pricing.note: This article states no price, subscription or cost figure; the only cost reference is that no cost claim is made because no live API key was used.

dates_versions.note: Original publication date 2026-04-22 is preserved unchanged; lastmod and the JSON-LD dateModified are set to 2026-10-08 honestly; the library version and its release date come from PyPI and the vendor release page.

benchmarks.note: No benchmark, throughput or success-rate figure is asserted; the unsourced 'near-100% first-attempt success' and production-volume lines from the April FAQ were withdrawn rather than restated.

sponsorship.note: No paid placement, affiliate link or sponsored content was added; all links are vendor documentation or package metadata.

cover.note: The existing local cover /images/pydantic-ai-tutorial-2026.png is preserved byte-for-byte and its hash is recorded; no paid image generator was invoked.

review_scope: Writer-stage refresh, round 1; approved by the independent Quality Editor (BLO-4130 review, agent 12a4c0f6) on 2026-10-08. The reviewer independently re-fetched every cited vendor page and metadata endpoint, verified round 0's single correction (the Google row now publishes the vendor's documented `google:gemini-3.7-flash`) was applied exactly in the table, support paragraph and changelog bullet, and confirmed all other previously supported surfaces are unchanged. No approval was inherited from round 0: this round's bytes were re-verified end to end. See research/pydantic-ai-tutorial-2026-review.json.
evidence_note: Writer-stage probe records live in research/evidence/pydantic-ai-tutorial-2026/ inside the repository for controller verification only; the article states explicitly that these local runs are author-side verification and are not offered to readers as a downloadable dataset.

round1_correction.request: Round-0 review (research/pydantic-ai-tutorial-2026-review.json, verdict=rework): the Google row published `google:gemini-2.0-flash` while presenting the table as verified against the vendor's provider documentation; the cited vendor page documents `Agent('google:gemini-3.7-flash')` and contains no occurrence of gemini-2.0-flash.
round1_correction.resolution: Applied exactly as requested: the table row, the support paragraph and the changelog bullet now publish the vendor's documented `google:gemini-3.7-flash`. The `google:` / `google-cloud:` prefix correction is unchanged. The support paragraph was also extended to record that the library's UserError suggestion reads `google:gemini-2.0-flash` and that construction validates the prefix and not the model tag, which is why the earlier version treated the suggestion as current. Everything the reviewer listed as source-backed is unchanged.
round1_correction.vendor_quote_source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/main/docs/models/google.md line 43 (sha256 41c774c41a626cc19dcd660d0a0173e33ced67f6bec30421de7dfc5c6bbe2613) and the rendered https://pydantic.dev/docs/ai/models/google/, both read 2026-10-08.

approved_by_review.note: Independent primary-source review; 19 source_checks all supported; 0 unsupported; mechanical gate pass.
